proof_summary: Finite tables give Goldbach decompositions through 8012 and Lemoine decompositions through 15727; above those bounds, a counted witness has coefficient 1 for even inputs and 2 for odd inputs, directly yielding the required prime sums. For any bound \(a\), applying the hypothesis to \(n=2(a+8018)\) produces primes \(p\) and \(p-6\), and the witness inequality forces \(p-6>a\), proving cousin-prime pairs are unbounded and hence infinite.
